property_summary: Only the admin (deployer) may ever call setOwner; the mutant lets the current owner call it too, so after transferring ownership to an actor, a follow-up setOwner by that actor must revert in the reference but succeeds in the mutant.
change_summary: Change the require check from `msg.sender == admin` to `msg.sender == owner`, allowing the owner (not just admin) to call setOwner.
